about: Drift city character and room sheets. Facts only, each with its source; empty fields are undecided. See the drift-city skill, 'Character sheets'.

characters.name: You (Per Aspera)
characters.role: Bass player in the band that plays the Warmhouse at midnight.

facts.text: Plays upright bass: "an old instrument with a spruce body, built for Titan air".
Carries a bass case that bumps against the suit leg.

possessions: a pocket for clues: voucher, setlist, reed, patch, tape, card

characters.name: Mags
characters.role: Runs the bar at the Cold Tap, Ferry Street.

facts.text: "Mags at the Cold Tap hears everything said in this street."
Wipes the bar while she talks; puts a glass in front of you.
Scots speech ("didnae", "weans").

characters.name: Dex
characters.role: Runs the Low Orbit bar by the spaceport.

facts.text: "Dex runs the bar." The Asters sit along its window.
Says the Asters' words: "Ad astra per aspera"; "We took them."
Leans on the bar; speaks quietly about Nuala.
Harriet: "Tell Dex to stop being coy about" the oxygen.

characters.name: Oskar
characters.role: Drummer; plays the late jam in the Lantern Cellar.

facts.text: "Oskar is on the drums, as always, brushes on a snare, eyes shut."
Explains why a bass is louder in Titan air.
Kept Nuala's split reed.

characters.name: Nuala Fenn
characters.role: Leads the band; missing since noon at the start.

facts.text: "Nuala Fenn leads the band."
"Nuala built a horn for Titan air. A bellows that breathes the outside air and blows it through the pipe."
"Twenty years in a suit"; "My sister has a garden."
Taught the Asters "the rooftop thing: every launch, lamps up on the roofs".
Sits at gate 3 with her horn case across her knees and a torn voucher.

characters.name: Clerk Pell
characters.role: Org clerk behind the glass at gate 3.

facts.text: "Form 11-C ... Cancellation of passage, voluntary. It needs to be signed off."
Stamps and signs off forms.
"Ruth runs the club"; waits at the bottom with the tether car's door open.
Her tape of a first night, labelled in her handwriting: NUALA, FIRST NIGHT.

characters.name: Elder Harriet
characters.role: A founder, heard through the Org; with the clock set back she speaks as herself.

facts.text: Speaks through the Org's screen; snorts; "Tell them I was funnier than this."
Put the oxygen under the Low Orbit, "with the printer stock".

characters.name: TheOrg
characters.role: The city's AI; the first cargo shuttle's computer (backstory, drift-city skill).

facts.text: "The old ship's computer. The settlers built it to outlive them."
Its clock "can't tell an Earth year from a Saturn year from a Titan day".

game.feed: a ring of light, no face (heads.js)

open: visual identity: U1 and hexagon emblems (backstory)

facts.text: "Old Wren, the last flame-keeper, hasn't come for her ginger tea."
Came by at dusk "with her pole and flask".
Her ladder leans by the pagoda door; her lamp pole is gone.
"Pip, your old delivery drone ... its eye is yours, its speaker your voice."

characters.name: Brother Tam
characters.role: Keeps a radio at the pagoda.

facts.text: Sits by "a wardrobe-sized cabinet with an amber dial, listening to static".

characters.name: Obi
characters.role: At the Assembly rostrum before the vote.

facts.text: "Obi gathers papers at the rostrum, exhausted."
"Castellane from Lumen was asking after her."
Signature and a note about "off-world buyers".

characters.name: The woman in green (unassigned)
characters.role: Subject of the first novel page (novel/cellar.html); not yet anyone in a story.

facts.text: Seated on the cellar stage under a red lantern; keeps time with her hand (video panel b).

hair in a low updo; drop earrings; red lipstick
